title: Grandpa Shows Cops Why He’s Called ‘Wild Bill’
description:
An 83-year-old man was caught on dashcam trying to flee police on a lawnmower in Perry Township, Ohio. Miraculously, William Wackerly, aka "Wild Bill", escaped police on his lawnmower after multiple failed attempts to apprehend him. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
